samples.evidence: The new test at editor-on-cursor-move.test.ts:216 calls `editor.toggleList('unordered')` first, so every `forEachBlockInSelection` visit takes the `block.type === 'list-item'` path in editor.ts:2894-2907 / 2917-2932. The comment added at editor.ts:2909 justifies the notify by claiming `marginLeft` is read back through `getBlockStyle()`, but no test drives `indent()`/`outdent()` on a plain paragraph and asserts a cursor-move callback fires with `editor.getBlockStyle().marginLeft` updated (36 / back to 0). That branch also differs materially: it uses `doc.applyBlockStyle` and, unlike `toggleList`, `indent()` does not call `invalidateLayout()` — so the untested branch is the riskier one. Verified real coverage exists nowhere: grepped packages/docs/test for `indent()` and `marginLeft` (only text-box-editor.test.ts:334 `expect(() => api.indent()).not.toThrow()`, which asserts nothing about notification, and editor-tab-bullet.test.ts which asserts store state via Tab keys, not cursor-move callbacks).
